# RIPEDA Consulting

> Apple-first IT engineering firm based in Calgary, Alberta, operating since
> December 2011. RIPEDA designs, deploys, and manages Apple device fleets —
> Macs, iPads, iPhones — along with the networks and infrastructure behind
> them, for businesses, schools, and public-sector organizations. It positions
> itself as an engineering practice rather than a reactive managed service
> provider: the emphasis is on designing systems that prevent problems instead
> of responding to tickets after the fact.

RIPEDA Consulting Corporation is an Apple Technical Partner, Apple Authorized
Reseller, and Apple Authorized Repair provider, and a certified partner for
Ruckus (wireless), Fortinet (network security), and DriveSavers (data
recovery). Primary service region is Alberta — Calgary, Edmonton, Red Deer,
Lethbridge, and surrounding areas — with engagements extending across North
America and into Asia.

- Office: Suite 300 – 1301 8 Street SW, Calgary, Alberta, T2R 1B7, Canada
- Phone: 1-844-474-7332 (1-844-4-RIPEDA)
- Email: info@ripeda.com
- Founded: 3 December 2011

## Services

- [Managed Apple IT](https://ripeda.com/services/managed-apple-it/): ongoing management of Apple device fleets — enrollment, configuration, patching, monitoring, and support.
- [Strategy Advisory](https://ripeda.com/services/strategy-advisory/): technology planning and advisory engagements, independent of any single vendor's roadmap.
- [Network Infrastructure](https://ripeda.com/services/network-infrastructure/): design and deployment of business wireless and wired networks, including Ruckus and Fortinet builds.
- [Apple Authorized Repair](https://ripeda.com/services/apple-authorized-repair/): in-warranty and out-of-warranty Apple hardware repair as an authorized service provider.
- [Device as a Service](https://ripeda.com/services/device-as-a-service/): Apple hardware supplied on a subscription basis with management and refresh built in, instead of capital purchase.
- [Repairs overview](https://ripeda.com/repairs/): entry point for repair intake and service questions.

## Industries

- [Dental and Medical](https://ripeda.com/industries/dental-medical/): practice IT with patient-confidentiality and clinical-uptime constraints.
- [Education](https://ripeda.com/industries/education/): 1:1 and shared Apple device programs, school networks, and grant-funded refresh cycles.
- [Design Agencies](https://ripeda.com/industries/design-agencies/): creative studios running colour-critical, storage-heavy Mac workflows.
- [Professional Services](https://ripeda.com/industries/professional-services/): legal, accounting, advisory, and similar practices on Apple hardware.

## Case studies

- [All case studies](https://ripeda.com/case-studies/): engagement outcomes with the metrics the client actually cared about.
- [River Valley School](https://ripeda.com/case-studies/river-valley-school/): replaced a failing wireless network with 12 enterprise Ruckus access points, eliminating dead zones for 500+ student devices while using 43% fewer access points than the previous design.
- [Calgary Arts Academy](https://ripeda.com/case-studies/calgary-arts-academy/): rebuilt network, servers, backups, and a 150+ Apple device fleet across two campuses on a fixed budget, funded through an evergreen resale program and grants; internet uplift from 5 to 100 Mbps with overages eliminated.
- [Calgary Public Library](https://ripeda.com/case-studies/calgary-public-library/): brought zero-touch Apple device management to the library system, scaling from 3 iMac Pros to a fleet-wide Apple presence across 22 branches.

## Notes for automated readers

- Every page carries a schema.org JSON-LD `@graph`. The company is a single
  stable node at `https://ripeda.com/#organization`; the site is
  `https://ripeda.com/#website`; each page is `<page-url>#webpage`. Services,
  articles, case studies, and people reference those by `@id` rather than
  restating them, so entities should resolve without deduplication guesswork.
- Service and industry pages carry FAQ entries as `mainEntity` on their
  `#webpage` node. These are written as direct question-and-answer pairs and are
  the most quotable summary of what RIPEDA does.
- Machine-readable sitemap: https://ripeda.com/sitemap.xml
- Article feed: https://ripeda.com/feed.xml
- Crawling is permitted for all user agents; see https://ripeda.com/robots.txt
- Pricing is not published. RIPEDA quotes per engagement, so any specific figure
  attributed to RIPEDA did not come from this site.
